bio.name: Brittany Siminitz
bio.title: JCK Contributing Editor
bio.summary: Brittany — Britt to most of the jewelry industry — has covered fine jewelry, gemstones, and the business of the trade since 2012, with more than 3,600 articles to her name. She's a Contributing Editor at JCK, the industry's leading publication, where she writes the On Your Market, Social Setting, and Supplier News blogs and the long-running Britt's Pick column. Her byline also appears in Gem + Jewel, the Substack and print magazine from Jewelers Mutual Group; in Rio Grande's Knowledge Hub; and in editorial features for fine jewelry brands.
